blocks.x: The budget is where priorities are declared and enforced.
blocks.in: Article 112 Annual Financial Statement; presentation on **1 February**; railway budget merged and plan/non-plan abolished in **2017**.
blocks.w: Read the budget as a **statement of whose claims prevailed**.

blocks.x: **Preparation → enactment → execution → audit**, with the legislature controlling each stage in principle.
blocks.in: DRSC scrutiny of demands; the **guillotine**; Appropriation Bill (114); Finance Bill (117) with a 75-day limit; PFMS in execution; CAG then PAC.
blocks.w: Most demands pass **under the guillotine without discussion** — the honest limit of control.

blocks.x: Accounting was separated from audit so that the auditor does not audit his own records.
blocks.in: Controller General of Accounts for Union accounts; CAG for audit; **DPC Act, 1971** gives a six-year tenure and a post-retirement bar.
blocks.gl: GAO and Treasury separation in the US.
blocks.w: Separation of accounts from audit is a **structural guarantee of independence**.

blocks.t: CAG and PAC — the accountability chain
blocks.x: The CAG audits, reports to the President, and the **PAC** examines those reports.
blocks.th: Article 151; PAC (1921), 22 members, chaired by the Opposition by convention.
blocks.in: Landmark performance audits — 2G, coal, Ayushman Bharat; excess grants regularised only after PAC scrutiny.
blocks.w: Name the three limits: **PPP jurisdiction, the audit-to-PAC lag, and unenforceable findings**.

blocks.x: **PAC** looks backward at money spent; **Estimates** looks forward at whether the estimate is economical; **COPU** covers public undertakings.
blocks.in: PAC 22 members with Opposition chair; Estimates 30, Lok Sabha only, no CAG support; COPU 22.
blocks.w: Confusing PAC with Estimates is a **common and costly error**.

blocks.x: Financial scrutiny placed **inside** the spending ministry rather than outside it.
blocks.th: **Integrated Financial Adviser scheme, 1975** — dual control by ministry and Finance Ministry.
blocks.in: The FA vets proposals before they reach the Finance Ministry.
blocks.gl: Treasury officers embedded in departments in the UK.
blocks.w: Dual control trades **independence for relevance** — deliberately.

blocks.x: States spend most and raise least, so transfers are the hinge of the system.
blocks.in: **16th FC (2026-31)** — 41% share, new **10% GDP-contribution weight**, tax effort dropped, ~₹1.4 lakh crore FY27 grants; cesses outside the pool; **Single Nodal Agency** just-in-time release.
blocks.w: The live disputes are **cesses, CSS conditionality and SNA float control**.

blocks.x: Statutory limits binding governments against short-termism.
blocks.th: **FRBM 2003**; **N.K. Singh (2017)** — debt anchor, escape clause, **Fiscal Council** (never created).
blocks.in: FY27 deficit 4.3%, debt 55.6%; 16th FC path of 3.5% by 2030-31 and 3% of GSDP for states; **off-budget borrowing to be discontinued**.
blocks.w: India shifted from a **deficit anchor to a debt path** — state that shift.

blocks.in: Outcome Budget accompanying demands since 2005-06; **Gender Budget Statement** since 2005-06; PFMS end-to-end tracking; DBT with ₹3.48 lakh crore estimated savings.
blocks.w: Outcome budgeting's weakness is **indicator quality**, not the concept.
